reference.source: analytic uniform square aperture and straight track geometry; no simulated fit

acceptance.physical: abs(Phi-N/144)<=1e-6*(N/144)+3*sigma_observed; sigma_observed=abs(Phi)*valid fluence rel_error; random hit count need not equal its expectation
acceptance.implementation: Sum weighted proton path lengths in hits / independent volume equals Phi within 1e-9 relative and printed precision; per-event accepted path sum must match one straight traversal to printed precision
acceptance.statistics: all completed events N including misses; theoretical Bernoulli model is diagnostic, not a demand for exact observed Np; rel_error=sqrt(1/K-1/N) for this unit-weight aperture case
acceptance.evidence: actual completed N=20000, input/backend/output SHA, valid summary/metadata, finite estimator; zero or absent scorer must not pass
acceptance.failure_action: preserve; no post hoc seeds, N, geometry, tolerance or physics changes

scope: one uniform source aperture in effectively empty Galactic material; no scattering/material transport validation
